entries.odia: ତୁ ତ ନୋହୁ, ତୁ କାହିଁ ପାଇଁ ଦିହକୁ ନଉ
entries.title: Was the remark meant for you?
entries.literal_meaning: You are not the one; why are you taking it personally?
entries.explanation: The speaker denies that the listener is the target, then questions the listener’s hurt. The dictionary places the line under taking something personally, not accepting responsibility. Our reading asks how the intended target and the felt effect may differ. The speaker’s denial does not prove that the listener has no reason to be hurt.
entries.meaning_odia: ବକ୍ତା କହୁଛନ୍ତି, କଥାଟି ଶ୍ରୋତାଙ୍କୁ ଲକ୍ଷ କରି କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ; ତେବେ ସେ କାହିଁକି ମନକୁ ନେଉଛନ୍ତି? ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ଭାବେ ନେବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି, ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ନେବା ଅର୍ଥରେ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠ କଥାର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଓ ତାହାର ପ୍ରଭାବର ଫରକକୁ ପଚାରେ। ବକ୍ତା ଅସ୍ୱୀକାର କଲେ ବୋଲି ଶ୍ରୋତାଙ୍କ ମନଦୁଃଖ ଅକାରଣ ହୋଇଯାଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading distinguishes the speaker’s stated target from the listener’s experience.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ କୁହାଯାଇଥିବା ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଓ ଶ୍ରୋତାଙ୍କ ଅନୁଭବକୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ସଭାରେ ଏକ ମନ୍ତବ୍ୟ ଶୁଣି ଜଣେ ସଦସ୍ୟ ଅସ୍ୱସ୍ତି ଜଣାଇଲେ। ବକ୍ତା କେବଳ ଅସ୍ୱୀକାର ନ କରି ନିଜ କଥା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କଲେ। / A speaker clarifies a remark after a listener expresses discomfort. This peaceful continuation is invented.
entries.cultural_context: No particular offense, relationship or justified dismissal is established. The speaker’s claim is quoted rhetoric, not an independently verified account.

entries.odia: ଆଜି ମଙ୍ଗନ କାଲି ବାହା, କିସ କରୁଅଛି କନିଆର ମାଆ
entries.title: The wedding is tomorrow
entries.literal_meaning: Today is mangana, tomorrow the wedding; what is the bride’s mother doing?
entries.explanation: The line puts a question beside an approaching event: today, then tomorrow. The headword explains mangana through the eve of a marriage. Our reading hears urgency in that sequence, while leaving the mother’s actual activity unknown. Nothing here establishes that she has neglected a duty or that preparation belongs to her alone.
entries.meaning_odia: ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ନିକଟେଇ ଆସୁଥିବା ଘଟଣା ପାଖରେ ଏକ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ରଖେ—ଆଜି, ତାପରେ କାଲି। ଶବ୍ଦର ଅର୍ଥରେ ମଙ୍ଗନକୁ ବିବାହର ପୂର୍ବଦିନ ସହ ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏହି କ୍ରମରେ ତତ୍ପରତାର ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ମାଆ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ କଣ କରୁଛନ୍ତି ତାହା ଅଜଣା ରହେ। ସେ କର୍ତ୍ତବ୍ୟରେ ଅବହେଳା କରିଛନ୍ତି ବା ସବୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି କେବଳ ତାଙ୍କର କାମ, ଏହାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ଧାଡ଼ିରେ ନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading notices urgency without turning the question into proof of a mother’s failure.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ତତ୍ପରତାକୁ ଦେଖେ, ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟିକୁ ମାଆଙ୍କ ବିଫଳତାର ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: କାଲି ପାଠସଭା ଅଛି। ଆୟୋଜକମାନେ ଜଣକୁ ଦୋଷ ନ ଦେଇ ବାକି କାମ ଭାଗ କରିନେଲେ। / Organizers divide the remaining work before tomorrow’s reading event. This is an invented application, not a wedding account.
entries.cultural_context: Dictionary marriage-eve senses supply context, not evidence of a universal present-day custom, prescribed ritual or maternal obligation. Tone beyond the question remains an editorial reading.

entries.title: Wisdom and curry received from others
entries.literal_meaning: Wisdom taught by someone else; curry asked for and brought.
entries.explanation: The fragment places received counsel beside received food. The headword explains a plan or understanding gained through another person’s teaching. Our reading follows that shared dependence on another’s contribution. The quotation supplies no ending about whether either will last, work or satisfy; it need not become a verdict against learning from others.
entries.meaning_odia: ଖଣ୍ଡବାକ୍ୟଟି ଅନ୍ୟଠାରୁ ଶିଖିଥିବା ବୁଦ୍ଧି ପାଖରେ ମାଗି ଆଣିଥିବା ତିଅଣକୁ ରଖେ। ଶବ୍ଦର ଅର୍ଥରେ ଅନ୍ୟର ଉପଦେଶରୁ ମିଳିଥିବା ବୁଦ୍ଧି ବୁଝାଯାଏ। ଆମ ପାଠ ଦୁଇଟିରେ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣଙ୍କ ଅବଦାନ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭରତାକୁ ଦେଖେ। କେତେଦିନ ରହିବ, କାମରେ ଆସିବ କି ସନ୍ତୋଷ ଦେବ, ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ତାହାର ଉତ୍ତର ଦେଇନାହିଁ। ଅନ୍ୟଠାରୁ ଶିଖିବା ବିରୋଧରେ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ଯୋଡ଼ିବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading follows a shared source of help without inventing the fragment’s conclusion.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଦୁଇଟିରେ ଅନ୍ୟର ସାହାଯ୍ୟକୁ ଦେଖେ, ଅକୁହା ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷ ଯୋଡ଼େନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠକମାନେ ଦୁଇଟି ଛବିର ସାଦୃଶ୍ୟ ଆଲୋଚନା କଲେ। ଧାଡ଼ିରେ ନଥିବା ଶେଷକଥା ଯୋଡ଼ିବାଠାରୁ ସେମାନେ ବିରତ ରହିଲେ। / Readers discuss the pairing without completing it with an invented maxim. This scene is original.
